posts.image_text: Strategy is one clear choice.
posts.title: Strategy is one clear choice.

captions.instagram_facebook:
Strategy is one clear choice.

Ask ten founders for their strategy and most will hand you a plan. Goals, projects, a slide for every department. It looks thorough. It is also impossible to remember, and what people cannot remember, they cannot follow.

A strategy is simpler. It is the one choice that makes every other choice easier. Southwest flew one type of plane. A good restaurant cooks four dishes. Apple, in 1997, cut its range to four.

This week's Journal: why keeping every door open is the usual failure, and a one-page test you can run before you plan next year.

Read it on the Basata Journal. Link in bio.

posts.image_text: Cut your plan in half. / List everything you plan to do next year. / Cross out what customers wouldn't miss. / Do the rest well.
posts.title: Cut your plan in half.

captions.instagram_facebook:
Cut your plan in half.

1. List everything you plan to do next year.
2. Cross out what customers wouldn't miss.
3. Do the rest well.

It feels like losing work. In practice you get the time back to do the rest properly. Customers notice quality long before they notice quantity.
